The Military Post Office Site Lead manages daily MPO operations at an assigned overseas installation. This role leads contract personnel, ensures secure and reliable mail services, maintains compliance with military postal requirements, and serves as the on-site point of contact for Government and installation stakeholders. The Site Lead drives operational discipline, customer service, accountability, and mission readiness across all assigned postal functions.
As required by our governmental client, this position requires an active SECRET clearance to be considered.

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.
Estimated Starting Salary Range for Site Lead: TBD
Full-time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.
